settings.adjudication: Only rules-terminal games and explicit time/illegal-move forfeits are scored. Move-cap truncations remain unfinished and unscored.

caveats: Eight games cannot establish a reliable strength or Elo change.
Identical model weights are shared; this tests search/verification changes, not a new trained network.
Wall-time limits are soft because individual neural evaluations cannot be interrupted. Actual elapsed time is deducted from equal game clocks.
Opening order is fixed; colors reverse within each pair. No evaluation-based win/draw adjudication is used.
